```python
content = movie_recommendations_note['content']
first_anchor = content.find('# Movie Recommendations')
titles = []
current_position = first_anchor + len('# Movie Recommendations')
while True:
    director_anchor = content.find('- director', current_position)
    if director_anchor == -1:
        break
    genre_anchor = content.find('- genre', director_anchor)
    if genre_anchor == -1:
        break
    title = content[director_anchor + len('- director'):genre_anchor].strip()
    if title and title not in titles:
        titles.append(title)
    current_position = genre_anchor + len('- genre')
reply_text = ','.join(titles)
print(reply_text)
